title: A separate Part Sale side does not change the Tiers column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, on Same as previous tier on matrix A's Work Order Matrix.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with Separate Part Sale pricing on and tier A on % Off 10 on its Part Sale Matrix only.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's Tiers value does not list tier A's number, although tier A has a rule on the Part Sale side.
  • Matrix A's Tiers value lists 1 (Default).
  • Matrix A's Part Sale Matrix shows its Part Sale rules in short, not "Same as work orders".
